_comment: Claude Desktop only. Drop this into %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (Windows) or ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS); merge the mcpServers entry if the file already exists. Claude Code does NOT read this file — use `claude mcp add --scope user modwrench -- npx -y @modwrench/cli` instead.
_credentials: Do not put API keys in this file. ModWrench reads credentials only from your OS credential manager. Run `npx -y @modwrench/cli auth key nexus` (or `auth key modio`) once to store yours.
_from_source: To run a local clone instead of the published package, replace the entry with {"command": "node", "args": ["<absolute path to your clone>/packages/cli/dist/index.js"]} after running `npm install && npm run build`.
